Put your built .rom images in this folder (copyrighted; not included).

Each supported set has a .mra recipe here. Build one with the MAME romset
of the same name:

    mra berzerk.mra        writes berzerk.rom
    mra frenzy.mra         writes frenzy.rom

Sets: berzerk, berzerka, berzerkb, berzerkf, berzerkg, berzerks, frenzy.

The five berzerk variants are split clones, so keep the parent berzerk.zip
alongside the clone zip when building them. Frenzy is self-contained.

Keep the .rom files in this folder and on your Pocket SD card, then pick the
game from the core's menu.
